period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Sourced from the bank's own full unaudited interim financial statements PDF ('Half Yearly Un-Audited Financial Statements 30 June 2026'), the same 24-page scanned-document format as 2026_Q1.json, containing full Consolidated AND separate/Solo statements. BASIS: SOLO/SEPARATE, taken from the pages explicitly headed 'Shahjalal Islami Bank PLC.' -- verified via this Solo Balance Sheet's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column (Total Property and Assets 427,425,708,361), which reproduces the dataset's already-validated quarterly/2025_Q4.json Solo figure exactly. EXTRACTION METHOD: same as 2026_Q1.json -- pdftotext extracted 0 lines (scanned document), so all figures below were read directly from 300dpi page renders of the Solo Balance Sheet (p.6), Solo Off-balance Sheet Items (p.7), and Solo Profit and Loss Account (p.8), not OCR'd. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (column header 'Jan'26 to Jun'26'), consistent with this bank's established _cumulative-suffix convention. UNUSUALLY RICH SOURCE: this filing's Solo P&L also discloses a bonus discrete Apr-Jun 2026 column (not stored as line_items, used only for cross-validation): Investment Income 7,199,622,641; Total Operating Income 6,167,552,109; Total Operating Expenses 1,813,068,822; Profit before Provision 4,354,483,288; Total Provision 856,723,895; PBT 3,497,759,393; Tax 1,654,233,617; discrete-Q2 Net Profit after Tax 1,843,525,776; discrete-Q2 EPS 1.66. Cross-check: 2026_Q1.json's cumulative PAT (1,262,274,184) + this bonus discrete-Q2 PAT (1,843,525,776) = 3,105,799,960, matching this file's own H1-cumulative Net Profit after Tax of 3,105,799,959 to within BDT 1 rounding -- strong confirmation both quarters were read correctly. VALIDATED: Total Liabilities 425,101,878,225 + Total Shareholders' Equity 27,056,753,448 = 452,158,631,673, matching reported Total Property and Assets 452,158,631,674 to within BDT 1 rounding (balance-sheet identity holds); Total Operating Income 11,814,970,637 - Total Operating Expenses 3,444,279,721 = Profit before Provision 8,370,690,916 (exact); Profit before Provision - Total Provision 1,969,353,996 = Total Profit before Taxes 6,401,336,920 (exact); Total Profit before Taxes - Tax 3,295,536,961 = Net Profit after Taxation 3,105,799,959 (exact, matches reported PAT to the taka). No classified-investment/NPL breakdown or Capital Adequacy (CRAR) disclosure is present anywhere in this 24-page interim filing (same genuine gap as 2026_Q1.json, confirmed by reading through to the final note) -- npl_pct/car_pct/classified_investments are not populated for this quarter for that reason, not a research gap.
